title: Python turtle reference
summary: Commands you can click to insert, with what each one does.

items.label: forward
items.hint: Move the turtle forward. The number is how many steps.

items.label: backward
items.hint: Move the turtle backward without turning.

items.label: right
items.hint: Turn clockwise by this many degrees.

items.label: left
items.hint: Turn anticlockwise by this many degrees.

items.label: goto
items.hint: Jump to a position. (0, 0) is the centre; x goes right, y goes up.

items.label: setheading
items.hint: Face a direction. 0 is right, 90 is up, 180 is left.

items.label: home
items.hint: Go back to the centre, facing right.
items.shows: Back to the centre, facing right

items.label: penup
items.hint: Lift the pen so moving does not draw.
items.shows: Pen up for the middle part

items.label: pendown
items.hint: Put the pen down so moving draws again.
items.shows: Pen down again for the last part

items.label: pensize
items.hint: Set how thick the line is.

items.label: pencolor
items.hint: Set the line colour, using a colour name.

items.label: dot
items.hint: Draw a filled dot of this size.

items.label: write
items.hint: Write text at the turtle's position.

items.label: fillcolor
items.hint: Choose the colour to fill shapes with.

items.label: begin_fill / end_fill
items.hint: Everything drawn between these two lines is filled in.
items.example:
fillcolor("orange")
begin_fill()
for i in range(4):
    forward(60)
    right(90)
end_fill()

items.label: bgcolor
items.hint: Set the background colour.

items.label: hideturtle
items.hint: Hide the turtle so only the drawing shows.
items.shows: The line stays; the turtle is hidden

items.label: speed
items.hint: How fast the turtle moves, from 1 (slow) to 10 (fast).

items.label: clear
items.hint: Wipe the drawing.

items.label: circle
items.hint: Draw a circle with this radius.
items.shows: circle(50) starts at the turtle and curves left

items.label: square (loop)
items.hint: Draw a square by repeating forward and right four times.

items.label: for loop
items.hint: Repeat the indented lines this many times.
items.example:
for i in range(5):
    forward(15)
    penup()
    forward(10)
    pendown()

items.label: while loop
items.hint: Repeat the indented lines for as long as the condition is true.
items.example:
r = 10
while r < 60:
    circle(r)
    r = r + 15
items.shows: A circle each time, while r < 60

items.label: if / else
items.hint: Do one thing or the other, depending on a condition.

items.label: variable
items.hint: Give a value a name, so you can reuse and change it.

items.label: list
items.hint: Keep many values in order under one name. The first item is place 0.

items.label: for each item
items.hint: Work through a list, one item at a time.
items.example:
pensize(6)
for c in ["red", "blue", "green"]:
    pencolor(c)
    forward(40)
items.shows: One line per colour in the list

items.label: def (function)
items.hint: Name a group of steps, then run it by calling its name.
items.example:
def zigzag():
    left(45)
    forward(30)
    right(90)
    forward(30)
    left(45)

zigzag()
zigzag()
zigzag()

items.label: print
items.hint: Show text or a value in the output box.

items.label: random number
items.hint: Pick a random whole number between two values.

items.label: onscreenclick
items.code:
def ‹stamp›(x, y):
    goto(x, y)
    dot(‹20›)

onscreenclick(‹stamp›)
listen()
mainloop()
items.hint: Run a function every time the picture is clicked. It receives the click position.
items.example:
def stamp(x, y):
    goto(x, y)
    dot(20)

penup()
stamp(-60, 30)
stamp(50, -20)
hideturtle()

items.label: onkey
items.hint: Run a function every time a key is pressed. Click the picture first so it receives keys.
items.example:
def go_up():
    forward(20)

go_up()
go_up()
go_up()

items.label: ontimer
items.hint: Run a function again after a number of milliseconds. A function can start its own timer.

items.label: numinput
items.hint: Ask for a number in a pop-up. The answer is None if the pop-up is cancelled.

items.label: textinput
items.hint: Ask for text in a pop-up.
